## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of what problem this feature solves (e.g., "I'm always frustrated when...").

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives Considered
A description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Constitutional & Architectural Alignment
How does this feature respect Ariadne's core principle (*"LLMs reason. Deterministic tools calculate. Validators verify. Humans decide."*)?
- [ ] Does NOT allow an AI agent to execute binding decisions autonomously.
- [ ] Does NOT use an LLM to hallucinate GIS coordinates, geometry, or simulation scores.
- [ ] Maintains typed schemas and deterministic validation.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, sketches, or references here.
